title: The Schema-First Test
document_title: Agent Field Notes No. 002 — The Schema-First Test

source.name: GitHub Changelog
source.title: Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot

verified_facts.claim: Eight more services connect via GitHub-verified MCP servers, in public preview
verified_facts.quote: You can now connect eight more services to Copilot using GitHub-verified MCP servers, or connectors, available in public preview.

verified_facts.claim: Connect in the Copilot app via Customize
verified_facts.quote: Copilot app : Open Customize and select Connect on the service you want.

verified_facts.claim: Public preview for all plans; Business/Enterprise admin policy
verified_facts.quote: Connectors are in public preview for all Copilot plans. With Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise, an admin needs to enable the Editor preview features policy.

verified_facts.claim: Example of checking the Supabase schema before a migration
verified_facts.quote: For example, you can ask Copilot why your latest Buildkite build failed and have it fix the code in the same session, or have it check your Supabase schema before it writes a migration.
